meta.environment: *fill* — CICS test region (or a COBOL unit harness driving the 88-byte parameter area)
meta.author: modernizeX

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Success code 'I0001' returns the completion message
cases.precondition: F-STD. The caller places code 'I0001' in the 6-character message-code input field.
cases.steps:
1. Clear the 88-byte communication area
2. Set the message code to 'I0001'
3. Invoke the message-text retriever and inspect the returned area
cases.expected: The message text is set to "Operation completed successfully." and the status field is '00' (found).
cases.remark: B3 · KM-CODE='I0001' → KM-TEXT (L20); KM-STATUS='00' (L18) · 0000-MAIN · KMSG-PARM · info code

cases.mid: 出力・帳票 (Output / report)
cases.name: Returned 88-byte area — field layout after a successful lookup
cases.precondition: F-STD. The caller places code 'I0001' in the 6-character message-code input field.
cases.steps:
1. Clear the 88-byte communication area
2. Set the message code to 'I0001'
3. Invoke the message-text retriever
4. Inspect each field of the returned area by byte position
cases.expected: The input code is unchanged in bytes 1-6 ('I0001' left-justified); the text "Operation completed successfully." occupies bytes 7-86 left-justified, the remainder space-padded (no truncation); the status '00' occupies bytes 87-88.
cases.remark: B4 · output record KMSG-PARM (88 bytes): KM-CODE 1-6, KM-TEXT 7-86 X(80), KM-STATUS 87-88 · SDD-CPY-015

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Status field is reset to '00' on every call (stale value overwritten)
cases.precondition: F-STD. The caller pre-fills the status field with a stale value '99' and places code 'E0001' in the message-code input field.
cases.steps:
1. Set the status field to '99' and the message code to 'E0001'
2. Invoke the message-text retriever
3. Inspect the returned status field
cases.expected: The stale '99' is overwritten: the returned status is '00' (found) and the text is "Record not found." — the status is unconditionally initialised at entry regardless of the incoming value.
cases.remark: B5 · MOVE '00' TO KM-STATUS unconditional at entry (L18) before EVALUATE · 0000-MAIN

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Idempotent repeat — same code twice yields identical output, no side effects
cases.precondition: F-STD. The caller places code 'E0002' in the message-code input field.
cases.steps:
1. Invoke the message-text retriever with code 'E0002' and capture the returned text and status
2. Clear and re-set code 'E0002' and invoke it a second time
3. Compare the two results and check for any external effect
cases.expected: Both calls return identical output — text "Duplicate record." and status '00'; no file, table, or queue is touched (the module has no I/O), so repeated calls are fully idempotent.
cases.remark: B8 · no file_selects / no SQL / no CALL — pure logic; deterministic EVALUATE · 0000-MAIN

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: No carry-over — a known code after a not-found call returns status '00'
cases.precondition: F-STD. Two sequential calls sharing one communication area.
cases.steps:
1. First call: set an unknown code 'Z9999' and invoke the retriever (status becomes '01')
2. Reuse the same area: set a known code 'I0001'
3. Invoke the retriever a second time and inspect the returned status
cases.expected: The second call returns status '00' and text "Operation completed successfully." — the not-found status '01' from the first call does not carry over, because the status is re-initialised at each entry.
cases.remark: B5 · re-entry resets KM-STATUS='00' (L18) each call; OTHER→'01' (L31) not sticky · 0000-MAIN

cases.mid: 連携・インターフェース (Linkage / interface)
cases.name: Invocation via the shared communication area (screen-linked call)
cases.precondition: F-STD. A calling screen program supplies code 'E0003' in the shared communication area.
cases.steps:
1. The calling screen program places 'E0003' in the shared 88-byte area
2. It links to the message-text retriever, passing that area
3. On return, the screen program reads the text and status from the same area
cases.expected: On return the same area carries the text "Please enter required fields." and status '00'; the contract is fulfilled in place — the caller passes the code and receives text + status in the one area.
cases.remark: B2 · EXEC CICS LINK PROGRAM('OUMSG') COMMAREA(KMSG-PARM); PROCEDURE DIVISION USING KMSG-PARM (L16); GOBACK (L33)

cases.mid: 連携・インターフェース (Linkage / interface)
cases.name: Invocation via static call passing the parameter area
cases.precondition: F-STD. A caller invokes the retriever by static call, passing the parameter area with code 'W0001'.
cases.steps:
1. The caller sets 'W0001' in the parameter area
2. It invokes the retriever by static call, passing that area
3. On return it reads the text and status
cases.expected: Behaviour is identical to the linked invocation — text "No records to display." and status '00'; the module honours both invocation styles documented in its interface.
cases.remark: B2 · CALL 'OUMSG' USING KMSG-PARM (source header L6); same USING interface (L16)

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Unknown code — not-found status '01' with the code echoed back
cases.precondition: F-STD. The caller places an unrecognised code 'Z9999' (not in the catalog) in the message-code input field.
cases.steps:
1. Clear the 88-byte communication area
2. Set the message code to 'Z9999'
3. Invoke the message-text retriever and inspect the returned area
cases.expected: The status field is set to '01' (not found) and the text field echoes the input code back as 'Z9999' (no catalog text) — the fall-through branch for any code outside the catalog.
cases.remark: B7 · WHEN OTHER: KM-TEXT=KM-CODE (L30), KM-STATUS='01' (L31) · 0000-MAIN · abnormal signalled by status '01', not by a raised code

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Exact 5-char code with trailing space matches (padding boundary)
cases.precondition: F-STD. The caller places the 5-character code 'E0001' left-justified in the 6-byte input field (byte 6 = space).
cases.steps:
1. Set the input field to 'E0001' followed by one trailing space (6 bytes)
2. Invoke the message-text retriever
3. Inspect the returned text and status
cases.expected: The code matches: text "Record not found." and status '00'. A 5-character catalog code fills the 6-byte field via a trailing space, which is the valid-match boundary.
cases.remark: B9 · WHEN literals are 5 chars, KM-CODE X(06); alphanumeric compare pads with trailing space → match (L22)

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Non-space 6th byte defeats the match (length boundary)
cases.precondition: F-STD. The caller places 'E0001X' (6 significant characters) in the input field.
cases.steps:
1. Set the input field to 'E0001X' (byte 6 = 'X', no trailing space)
2. Invoke the message-text retriever
3. Inspect the returned text and status
cases.expected: No catalog entry matches (the 6th byte is not a space), so status is '01' (not found) and the text echoes 'E0001X'. The just-over boundary of a 5-char code plus one extra character.
cases.remark: B9 · KM-CODE='E0001X' ≠ 'E0001 ' → WHEN OTHER (L29-31); max+1 char boundary · 0000-MAIN

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Lowercase code does not match (case-sensitivity boundary)
cases.precondition: F-STD. The caller places the lowercase code 'e0001' in the input field.
cases.steps:
1. Set the input field to lowercase 'e0001'
2. Invoke the message-text retriever
3. Inspect the returned text and status
cases.expected: The comparison is case-sensitive, so lowercase 'e0001' does not match uppercase 'E0001': status is '01' (not found) and the text echoes 'e0001'.
cases.remark: B9 · exact alphanumeric compare, case-sensitive → WHEN OTHER (L29-31) · 0000-MAIN

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Leading space (right-shifted code) does not match
cases.precondition: F-STD. The caller places a leading space then 'E0001' (' E0001', 6 bytes) in the input field.
cases.steps:
1. Set the input field to one space followed by 'E0001' (6 bytes)
2. Invoke the message-text retriever
3. Inspect the returned text and status
cases.expected: The value is not left-justified, so it does not match 'E0001': status is '01' (not found) and the text echoes ' E0001'. Codes must be left-justified to match.
cases.remark: B9 · ' E0001' ≠ 'E0001 ' → WHEN OTHER (L29-31); justification boundary · 0000-MAIN

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Blank code (all spaces) falls through to not-found
cases.precondition: F-STD. The caller leaves the message-code input field blank (all 6 bytes spaces).
cases.steps:
1. Set the input field to 6 spaces
2. Invoke the message-text retriever
3. Inspect the returned text and status
cases.expected: A blank code matches no catalog entry: status is '01' (not found) and the text is set to the blank code (all spaces). The empty-input boundary.
cases.remark: B9 · spaces ≠ any WHEN literal → WHEN OTHER: KM-TEXT=spaces (L30), KM-STATUS='01' (L31) · 0000-MAIN

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Longest catalog text fits the 80-byte text field without truncation
cases.precondition: F-STD. The caller places code 'I0001' (whose text is the longest catalog entry) in the input field.
cases.steps:
1. Set the message code to 'I0001'
2. Invoke the message-text retriever
3. Inspect the full 80-byte text field
cases.expected: The 33-character text "Operation completed successfully." is returned in full within the 80-byte field, left-justified with the remaining 47 bytes space-padded — no truncation; the longest catalog text is well within capacity.
cases.remark: B9 · KM-TEXT X(80); longest literal 33 chars (L20) < 80 → fits, space-padded · capacity boundary
